notes: An add-on in MyPopPro beside any Manhattan plan, in every state. It is ACA minimum essential coverage, and Plans 2 and 3 add $0 Quest labs, so some clients layer it for ongoing testing.

A group plan: the client joins through the SB/A Cooperative (a non-profit agency cooperative) and completes the Group Health Application. Guaranteed issue, no medical questions. The agent must be appointed with USA Health Plans.
Preventive care is in network only (First Health PPO), limited to Family Practice, Internal Medicine and Pediatrics — office and other outpatient services.

Quest labs (Plans 2 and 3) are a separate subscription, not insurance. They do not cover labs ordered in the hospital, emergency (STAT) labs, testing sent to another lab, or esoteric tests such as fertility, bone marrow and spinal fluid. Imaging, X-ray, mammography and dental are not lab work.
Primary care and urgent care (Plan 3) are provided by HC2U, separate from the MEC plan. Telemedicine first; members book every appointment through the Patient Advocacy Line.
The RX copay card add-on is never included: the client's prescriptions are handled elsewhere.
The brochure is written for licensed agents. The Schedule of Benefits governs if anything differs.
